summary: Both full halves inspected. The g in augmentation has an older crowded type impression that remains unreadable. The cancelled integrat fragment includes an opening quote, and the cancelled Where has both typewriter cancellation and pen hatching, leaving its W uncertain. In interpreted the p descender, r shoulder, and e bowl remain separately visible but are displaced at roughly half the ordinary pitch; the group is kept with scoped uncertainty rather than reduced to a p-to-r replacement. The cancelled of before (11) is crossed in pen. Nested math delimiters and the phantom tilde in (11) are repaired without changing its notation. Groupoid ends in a clear pen d, and the old a under the o of resolu is visible. Iff has typed if plus one added pen f. Homological and its parentheses are typed above the line, with a repeated a impression. The margin X is retained without interpreting it as deletion. The line calls the proposed object strict integrator once, although special is the defined term; no wording is changed.

edits.reason: The g contains extra regular stems and a shoulder from an older type impression. Its identity cannot be securely recovered under the live g.
A typed opening double quote is visible before the cancelled i. The source fragment ends at integrat; no unseen completion is supplied.
The h,e,r,e forms remain readable. The first character is obscured by irregular pen hatching in addition to the typed x cancellation, so W remains doubtful.

The p descender, r shoulder, and e bowl are separate visible shapes but overlap at about half the normal typewriter pitch. Independent inspection supports retaining all three within a doubtful crowded group, without deciding that p was replaced by r.
The old of is legible, but its cancellation is irregular pen hatching rather than a regular typed x lattice.
The arrow is visibly hand-drawn; remove its redundant inner dollar delimiters inside the existing math span.
The lambda and tilde are handwritten, but the underlined Z is typed. Align the tilde over that Z and remove nested dollar delimiters from the display.
The second arrow is also hand-drawn within existing math; remove only the inner dollar pair.
The compound one-object continues at the next line with a visible leading hyphen. Join the physical break so no space is inserted into the compound.
The o retains the right upright and lower tail of an older typed a. The line-end hyphen itself is visible.
The i and first f are regular typing. Only the second f is added in pen, with a thick hooked descender.
The parenthesized word is typed above the line. Its a has two displaced regular bowls; the separate locating bracket is pen.
